transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdrawUnusedRewards(uint256).details: Bounded by `rewardReserve` — staked principal can never be withdrawn by the owner,      which is the whole point of separating the two balances.

claimRewards().notice: Take earned rewards without touching the principal.

currentApyBps().notice: Current annual rate in basis points, from the funded stream. 0 when unfunded.

fundRewards(uint256,uint256).notice: Fund the reward pool and stream it over `duration` seconds.

getStakeInfo(address).notice: Everything a UI needs, in one call.

minStakeAmount().notice: Smallest stake accepted. Below this the reward dust is not worth the gas.

rewardRate().notice: Rewards streamed per second while the pool is funded.

rewardReserve().notice: Tokens set aside to pay rewards. Never lent to principal, never staked.

rewardsEndAt().notice: When the current funding runs out. Accrual stops here.

stake(uint256).notice: Stake `amount`. Caller must have approved this contract first.

usdcToken().notice: The token being staked. Named to match the v1 interface.
